name: Sizzle
description: A skill that helps agents direct and produce short kinetic brand films with a narrator, a score and cut-downs, and then measure every frame and the mix.

film.title: Open late
film.brief: An invented town library wants students to know it stays open until midnight on Fridays. Fourteen seconds, no sound on this page.

cuts.label: First cut
cuts.summary: What a quick first pass looks like: everything on screen, nothing quite readable.

cuts.label: After the checks
cuts.summary: The same film after one round of fixes, each answering a finding.
changes: The question holds 2.4 s, revealed through a mask, instead of flashing for 1 s.
The headline leaves through its mask instead of jumping into a slide.
The list became three moments of its own, at 72 px, inside the window.
The day joined the headline, and the window light becomes its full stop.
The library's name moved inside the safe area, under the headline.
